note: The spec model's answer for LinearRAG.pdf as it came on 2026-10-13 (check.js --spec, the method-category prompt of c0e7fac): 27 conditions, all anchored, and 4 settings the paper does not state. Unedited: dataset sizes, the GPU, a baseline's settings and hedged sentences are in it, as a user gets them. The end-to-end bench (audit_bench.py state --conditions real) feeds it through PabloSkill.spec, before spec items carry a kind.

items.statement: HotpotQA는 약 97,000개의 질의-응답 인스턴스로 구성된다.
items.quote: A comprehensive benchmark comprising 97k question-answer instances designed to evaluate multi-hop reasoning capabilities.

items.statement: 2WikiMultiHopQA는 192,000개의 질문을 포함한다.
items.quote: A multi-hop reasoning benchmark containing 192k questions that necessitate information integration across multiple Wikipedia articles.

items.statement: MuSiQue는 25,000개의 질문-답변 쌍으로 구성된다.
items.quote: A sophisticated multi-hop QA benchmark featuring 25k question-answer pairs that demand 2-4 sequential reasoning steps.

items.statement: Medical 데이터셋은 총 4,076개의 질문으로 구성된다.
items.quote: The dataset encompasses four tasks of increasing complexity: fact retrieval, complex reasoning, contextual summarization, and creative generation, totaling 4,076 questions across all difficulty levels.

items.statement: 각 데이터셋의 검증 세트에서 1,000개의 질문을 선택한다.
items.quote: us- ing the same corpus for retrieval and choosing 1,000 questions from each validation set

items.statement: 각 passage는 구두점을 사용해 문장으로 분할한다.
items.quote: we first segment each passage into sentences using punctuation (e.g., periods or exclamation marks)

items.statement: 모든 방법은 all-mpnet-base-v2 임베딩 모델을 사용한다.
items.quote: all algorithms use the same embedding model,i.e., all-mpnet-base-v2

items.statement: 생성과 평가에는 GPT-4o-mini를 사용한다.
items.quote: All RAG approaches employ the same LLM (GPT-4o-mini) for both generation and evaluation tasks.

items.statement: 모든 방법의 top-k 검색값은 5이다.
items.quote: We setk= 5 for topkretrieval in all meth- ods.

items.statement: 동적 pruning 임계값 δ는 4로 설정한다.
items.quote: And, we setδ= 4based on our experimental setting.

items.statement: passage 초기 점수의 trade-off 계수 λ는 0.05에서 최적이다.
items.quote: optimal performance is achieved whenλtakes a relatively small value (e.g., 0.05)

items.statement: PageRank의 damping factor는 일반적으로 0.85이다.
items.quote: Here,dis the damping factor (typically 0.85)

items.statement: Contain-Match Accuracy는 생성된 응답에 정답이 포함되는지를 검사한다.
items.quote: Contain-Match Accuracy (Contain-Acc.), which checks if the correct answer appears in the generated response

items.statement: GPT-Evaluation Accuracy는 LLM이 예측 답변과 정답의 일치 여부를 평가한다.
items.quote: GPT-Evaluation Accuracy (GPT-ACC.), an LLM-based metric that assesses whether the pre- dicted answer matches the ground truth.

items.statement: Medical 데이터셋은 GPT-ACC.만으로 평가한다.
items.quote: For the Medical dataset, since golden answers consist of lengthy descriptive statements, we only evaluate using GPT-ACC.

items.statement: 주요 비교 대상으로 KGP, G-retriever, RAPTOR, E2GraphRAG, LightRAG, HippoRAG, GFM-RAG, HippoRAG2를 사용한다.
items.quote: including KGP (Wang et al., 2024), G-retriever (He et al., 2024), RAPTOR (Sarthi et al., 2024), E2GraphRAG (Zhao et al., 2025), LightRAG

items.statement: Vanilla RAG baseline은 1, 3, 5개 passage를 검색한다.
items.quote: We deploy Vanilla RAG methodologies across multiple retrieval configurations (retrieving 1, 3, or 5 top passages)

items.statement: 실험은 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 D 24GB GPU에서 수행한다.
items.quote: GPU NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 D (24GB VRAM)

items.statement: LinearRAG의 네 데이터셋별 주요 정확도 결과는 표에 보고된 값과 같다.
LinearRAG의 2Wiki GPT 기반 정확도는 63.70%이다.
items.quote: LinearRAG achieves 63.70% GPT-based accuracy on 2Wiki

items.statement: LinearRAG의 2Wiki Contain 기반 정확도는 70.20%이다.
items.quote: and boosts Contain-based accuracy to 70.20%.

items.statement: Tri-Graph는 entity, sentence, passage 노드와 entity-문장 및 entity-passage 연결로 구성된다.
items.quote: We construct a hierarchical graph, called Tri-graph, with multiple granularities that is efficient to maintain and update.

items.statement: 질문에서 추출한 각 entity는 그래프에서 가장 유사한 entity에 초기 활성화된다.
items.quote: Then for each extracted entity, we find the most similar entity in the knowl- edge graph.

items.statement: 문장-entity 그래프에서 질문-문장 유사도를 이용해 중간 entity의 활성화 점수를 전파한다.
items.quote: Semantic propagationthat propagates the similarities inσ q through semantic similarity extrac- tion to activate relevant intermediate entities

items.statement: 각 전파 단계에서 관련성 점수가 임계값을 넘는 새 entity만 다음 반복에 유지한다.
items.quote: A newly activated entity is retained for the next iteration only if its relevance score exceedsδ; otherwise, it is pruned.

items.statement: 활성화된 entity를 seed로 사용해 entity-passage 그래프에서 Personalized PageRank로 passage 중요도를 집계한다.
items.quote: The second stage performs global impor- tance aggregation with hybrid initialization for passage nodes to retrieve important passages using Personalized PageRank

items.statement: 최종 검색 결과는 passage의 PageRank 점수가 높은 top-k passage이다.
items.quote: Passages are ranked by their PPR scoresI(v|v∈V p), and the top-kpassages with the highest scores are selected for retrieval.
